derivation.formula: 100 - 4.5 x (MBS_CC - coupon), with a convexity haircut on the wings
derivation.note: Duration 4.5 is a current-coupon TBA approximation. The production coupon is pinned to today and held constant across history so the series does not print a fake 72-tick jump at a rounding boundary.

move.detail: +1 bp. Bigger in magnitude than 98% of the 2703 moves since 2016-01-08. The typical move is 0.2 bp; this is 2.9 sigma.

insights.stat_line: Sitting in the bottom of its 1-year range, at the 8th percentile.

impact.meaning: A RISE in this series pushes mortgage rates DOWN. A fall pushes them UP.

chains.chain: MBS price → ↓ MBS yield → ↓ 30Y mortgage rate
rationales: Price and yield are two views of the same number. Prices up means yields down.
Lenders price off MBS execution, with a short lag for rate sheets.
